svg.aria-label: MQM error points per 100 source words by model, per judge, sets A and B
svg.text: Set A: 10 historical clips (HY reference texts)
Set B: 10 newer clips (reference resembles OpusBig)
Error points per 100 source words, lower is better. Whiskers: 95% interval over clips. Right column: both judges on one scale. An arrow means off the scale.
Blue: run by this repo. Green: tool output committed by HY. Purple: older HY outputs as shipped in the toolkit samples. Grey: HY's reference text.
